id: Would you like to go back?
en: Would you like to go back?

id: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
en: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
it: Stai per affrontare un Pokémon leggendario che, se non lo catturi qui, non sarà ottenibile fino al post-game. Vuoi salvare?

id: \bGladion: I'm getting word from the others that things are returning to normal back home. Looks like dealing with this Pokémon worked.
en: \bGladion: I'm getting word from the others that things are returning to normal back home. Looks like dealing with this Pokémon worked.
it: \bIridio: Gli altri mi dicono che a casa le cose stanno tornando alla normalità. Sembra che occuparsi di questo Pokémon abbia funzionato.

id: \rLusamine: \PN? Run while you can... It has control of me and my Pokémon... Oh no, it's too late!
en: \rLusamine: \PN? Run while you can... It has control of me and my Pokémon... Oh no, it's too late!
it: \rSamina: \PN? Scappa finché puoi... Controlla me e i miei Pokémon... Oh no, è troppo tardi!

id: \rLusamine: You did it. You drove it away. Let's get out of here quickly.
en: \rLusamine: You did it. You drove it away. Let's get out of here quickly.
it: \rSamina: Ce l'hai fatta. L'hai scacciato. Andiamocene da qui, presto.
